# ankra_proxmox_bridges (Data Source)

The bridges and SDN vnets of a Proxmox VE node, for `bridge` on `ankra_proxmox_cluster`. The counterpart of `ankra cluster proxmox bridges`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_proxmox_bridges" "pve1" {
  credential_id = ankra_proxmox_credential.lab.id
  node          = "pve1"
}

output "bridges" {
  value = data.ankra_proxmox_bridges.pve1.bridges[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (String) Credential to read the catalogue through.
- `node` (String) Proxmox VE node (host) name (`data.ankra_proxmox_hosts`).

### Read-Only

- `bridges` (Attributes List) Bridges of the node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bridges))

<a id="nestedatt--bridges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bridges`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the bridge is active.
- `cidr` (String) CIDR, when the bridge has one.
- `comments` (String) Comments.
- `name` (String) Bridge or vnet name.
- `source` (String) `bridge` for a host Linux bridge, `sdn` for an Ankra-managed SDN vnet.
